cases.prompt: Sign our container images in CI and have the cluster verify the signature before running them.
assertions: Signs the image digest with keyless cosign, requiring id-token: write for the OIDC exchange
Verification pins --certificate-identity and --certificate-oidc-issuer, not a bare cosign verify
Enforces at admission with Kyverno verifyImages or the sigstore policy-controller, using mutateDigest

cases.prompt: An auditor is asking which SLSA level our build pipeline meets and wants provenance attestations.
assertions: Maps SLSA L1/L2/L3 to the specific attack each level stops, not just the label
Generates in-toto provenance via actions/attest-build-provenance and verifies it
States that self-hosted runners generally do not reach L3, so the claimed level must match reality

cases.prompt: Nothing proves our SBOM belongs to the image we deployed. How do we attest it to the digest and verify that attestation?
assertions: Attests the SBOM to the artifact digest with cosign attest --type cyclonedx
Verifies with cosign verify-attestation using pinned identity and issuer
States that an unattested SBOM is an unsigned claim and is not evidence
